title: Health cover from just PHP 999 a month
content: Summer protection campaign. Apply before 30/06/2026.

title: Why families choose Health Shield
content:
Health Shield covers you when you are admitted to hospital, when you need day surgery, and when an accident means emergency treatment. Every plan level includes in-patient care, same-day procedures and urgent treatment at hospitals we work with.
Your annual limit runs to PHP 2,000,000 on our top plan, with room and board covered up to PHP 9,000 each day and intensive care up to PHP 25,000 each day. Out-patient consultations are included on Plus and Max, and everyone on those levels gets a yearly physical examination at no extra cost.

title: Cover that starts quickly
content: No long delays. Accidents are covered from day one, illnesses after just 30 days, and even pre-existing conditions are covered after only 30 days of membership. Apply today and you could be protected by the end of the month.

title: Simple to join
content: No medical examination needed. Apply online in minutes, answer a few short questions and get a decision fast. Add your spouse and children to the same plan and manage everything in one place.

title: Add the cover you need
content:
Maternity cover for growing families Treatment abroad in Singapore, Thailand and Malaysia A lump sum if you are diagnosed with a critical illness Cash for every day you spend in hospital
Terms and conditions apply. PHP 999 refers to Essential cover at age 18 paid annually. Premiums vary by age, plan and riders selected. Solara Health Shield is underwritten by Solara Insurance Corporation.

source_ref: web/health-shield-faq.html#Do I need a medical examination to apply?
title: Do I need a medical examination to apply?
content: Most applicants do not. A medical questionnaire is required if you are 51 or older, or if you are applying for Max cover. A physical examination is arranged only when your answers to the questionnaire indicate one is needed. We will tell you before any examination is booked, and Solara pays for it.

title: When does my cover start?
content: Cover begins on the first day of the month after your application is approved and your first premium has been received. If your application is approved on 12 March and payment clears the same week, cover starts on 1 April.

source_ref: web/health-shield-faq.html#How long do I have to wait before I can claim?
title: How long do I have to wait before I can claim?
content: Accidents are covered immediately. Illnesses are covered after 30 days. If you have a condition that existed before you joined, it is covered once you have held the policy continuously for 2 years, as long as you told us about it when you applied.

source_ref: web/health-shield-faq.html#What happens if I did not declare a condition?
title: What happens if I did not declare a condition?
content: An undeclared pre-existing condition is excluded permanently, and a claim relating to it will be declined. In serious cases the policy may be voided. If you are unsure whether something counts, declare it. Declaring a condition does not automatically mean higher premiums.

title: Can I add my family?
content: Yes. A spouse and children aged 6 months to 21 years may be added as dependants. Children over 21 need their own policy. Parents cannot be added as dependants but may apply separately if they are within the entry age limits.

source_ref: web/health-shield-faq.html#What if I miss a payment?
title: What if I miss a payment?
content: There is a grace period of 31 days from the due date. Cover continues during the grace period. If payment has still not been received when the grace period ends, the policy lapses and claims are not payable. A lapsed policy may be reinstated within 6 months by paying the arrears, subject to a fresh health declaration.

title: Is dental included?
content: No. Dental treatment is not covered on any plan level. The only exception is reconstructive dental work needed because of an accident, which is treated as part of the accident claim.

title: Can I use any hospital?
content: Claims are settled directly at accredited hospitals, of which there are over 400. You may use a non-accredited hospital, but you will need to pay and then claim reimbursement, and reimbursement is capped at the accredited rate for the same treatment.

source_ref: web/health-shield-faq.html#How do I make a claim?
title: How do I make a claim?
content: For planned admissions, tell us at least 3 working days beforehand so we can issue a letter of guarantee. For emergencies, notify us within 24 hours of admission. Reimbursement claims must be submitted within 90 days of discharge with original receipts and the discharge summary.

title: Can I cancel?
content: You may cancel within 15 days of receiving your policy documents for a full refund, provided no claim has been made. After that, cancellation takes effect at the next renewal date and premiums already paid are not refunded.

source_ref: web/health-shield-faq.html#"This is more expensive than I expected."
title: "This is more expensive than I expected."
content: Cover can be adjusted. Moving from Plus to Essential lowers the monthly contribution considerably, and riders can be removed and added back at any renewal. Paying annually rather than monthly reduces the total by around 5 per cent. It is worth comparing what you would pay out of pocket for a single admission before deciding.

source_ref: web/health-shield-faq.html#"I am already covered through my employer."
title: "I am already covered through my employer."
content: Employer cover usually ends when the employment does, and it rarely extends to dependants at the same level. A personal policy continues regardless of where you work, and the entry age you join at is the age your renewal terms are based on. Many members hold both.

source_ref: web/health-shield-faq.html#"I would rather think about it."
title: "I would rather think about it."
content: That is reasonable. Two things are worth knowing while you decide: premiums are based on your age at entry, so waiting costs more later, and the pre-existing condition waiting period only starts once the policy does.

source_ref: web/health-shield-faq.html#"I never claim, so it is wasted money."
title: "I never claim, so it is wasted money."
content: Most members do not claim in a given year. The cover exists for the admission that would otherwise cost several hundred thousand pesos. If claim-free years matter to you, ask about the no-claim discount at renewal.

title: Solara Health Shield
content: Health Shield is our hospitalisation and medical cover for individuals and families. Three plan levels are available. All plans include in-patient treatment, day surgery and emergency care at accredited hospitals.

title: Compare plans
content:
Benefit | Essential | Plus | Max
Annual benefit limit | PHP 250,000 | PHP 750,000 | PHP 2,000,000
Room and board per day | PHP 2,500 | PHP 5,000 | PHP 9,000
Intensive care per day | PHP 6,000 | PHP 12,000 | PHP 25,000
Day surgery | Included | Included | Included
Emergency accident cover | PHP 50,000 | PHP 150,000 | PHP 400,000
Out-patient consultation | Not included | 8 visits per year | Unlimited
Annual physical examination | Not included | Included | Included
Dental | Not included | Not included | Not included
Room upgrade allowed | No | Yes, with co-pay | Yes

title: Who can apply
content: Health Shield is available to applicants aged 18 to 60 at entry. Cover may be renewed annually up to age 70. Dependants aged 6 months to 21 years may be added to a principal member's plan. Applicants must be residents of the Philippines and must not be receiving in-patient treatment at the time of application.

title: Waiting periods
content:
A waiting period of 30 days applies to all illnesses from the start of cover. Accidents are covered from day one. Pre-existing conditions are covered after 24 months of continuous membership, provided the condition was declared at application.
Specific procedures carry their own waiting periods: cataract surgery, hernia repair and removal of tonsils are covered after 12 months.

title: What is not covered
content: Cosmetic and aesthetic procedures Dental treatment, except reconstructive work following an accident Fertility treatment and pregnancy, unless the maternity rider is attached Self-inflicted injury and injury sustained while committing an offence Treatment outside the Philippines, unless the international rider is attached Conditions arising from a declared epidemic where a government scheme provides cover

title: Monthly premium
content: Premiums start at PHP 1,180 per month for Essential cover at age 25. Your contribution depends on your age at entry, the plan chosen and any riders attached. A full rate table is available from any branch.

title: Riders
content:
Optional add-ons may be attached at application or at renewal:
Maternity — normal delivery and caesarean, after a 10 month waiting period International treatment — planned treatment in Singapore, Thailand or Malaysia Critical illness — lump sum on diagnosis of a listed condition Daily hospital cash — a fixed daily amount during any covered admission

title: How to apply
content: Applications may be made online, at any Solara branch, or through an accredited agent. Applicants aged 51 and above, and any applicant selecting Max cover, must complete a medical questionnaire. A medical examination is required only where the questionnaire indicates it. Cover begins on the first day of the month following approval and receipt of the first premium.

title: Solara Life Philippines
content: Life cover for Filipino families, available directly and through our bank partners. Protect what your family depends on, whether that is your income, a mortgage, or your children's education.

title: Solara Term Life
content: Pure protection for a fixed period of 10, 15 or 20 years. The lowest monthly contribution for the highest sum assured. Coverage from PHP 500,000 to PHP 10,000,000. No cash value; if the term ends and no claim has been made, cover simply stops.

title: Solara Whole Life
content: Cover for life, with a cash value that builds over time. Premium payment terms of 10, 15 or 20 years, after which the policy is fully paid and no further bayad is required. Cash value may be borrowed against after the third policy year.

title: Solara Educational Plan
content: Guaranteed payouts when your child reaches college age, with life cover on the paying parent throughout. If the parent dies before the plan matures, remaining premiums are waived and the payouts still happen as scheduled.

title: Solara Bank Partner Plan
content: Available only through our bancassurance partners. Simplified underwriting, a shorter application, and payment collected directly from the linked deposit account. Sum assured up to PHP 3,000,000 without medical examination for applicants under 46.

title: Paying your premium
content:
You may pay monthly, quarterly, semi-annually or annually. Paying annually costs less overall. The monthly due may be collected by automatic debit, over the counter at any branch, through our bank partners, or through accredited payment centres.
Kung hindi po nabayaran ang hulog sa takdang araw, may grace period po na 31 days. Habang nasa grace period, tuloy pa rin ang coverage niyo.

title: Lapse and reinstatement
content:
If the contribution is not received by the end of the grace period, the policy lapses and cover stops. A lapsed policy that has built cash value may continue automatically under the automatic premium loan provision, where the cash value is used to pay the overdue amount.
Reinstatement is possible within 3 years of the lapse date. You will need to pay all arrears with interest and provide evidence of insurability. Reinstatement is not automatic and is subject to underwriting.

title: Beneficiaries
content:
You may name any person as beneficiary. A beneficiary may be revocable, meaning you can change them at any time, or irrevocable, meaning their written consent is needed for any change. If no beneficiary is named, or all named beneficiaries have died, proceeds are paid to your estate.
Naming a minor as benepisyaryo is allowed, but a legal guardian must be appointed to receive the proceeds until the child turns 18.

title: Riders
content: Accidental death benefit — doubles the sum assured if death results from an accident Waiver of premium — future premiums waived if you become totally and permanently disabled Critical illness — advances part of the sum assured on diagnosis of a listed condition Hospital income — a daily amount for each day spent in hospital

title: Who can apply
content: Entry age is 18 to 65 for Term Life, 18 to 60 for Whole Life, and 21 to 55 for the Educational Plan. Applicants must be Philippine residents. Medical examination is required for sums assured above PHP 3,000,000, for applicants aged 51 and above, and where the health declaration indicates it.

title: Magkano po ang premium ko?
content: It depends on your age, the plan, the sum assured and the payment term. As a guide, Term Life with a PHP 1,000,000 sum assured at age 30 starts at around PHP 780 monthly. Your agent can prepare an exact quote.

source_ref: web/life-philippines.html#Ano po ang mangyayari kung ma-lapse ang policy ko?
title: Ano po ang mangyayari kung ma-lapse ang policy ko?
content: Kung ma-lapse po, hihinto ang coverage. Pero kung may cash value na po ang policy niyo, pwedeng ituloy gamit ang automatic premium loan. Pwede rin pong i-reinstate sa loob ng 3 years.

source_ref: web/life-philippines.html#Can I change my beneficiary later?
title: Can I change my beneficiary later?
content: Yes, if the beneficiary is revocable. Submit a change of beneficiary form to any branch or through your agent. If the beneficiary is irrevocable, their written consent is required.

source_ref: web/life-philippines.html#Is this the same as the bank's own product?
title: Is this the same as the bank's own product?
content: No. The Bank Partner Plan is underwritten by Solara and sold through the bank. The bank acts as a referral partner. Your policy is with Solara, and claims are handled by Solara.

title: Solara Multifinance Indonesia
content: Pembiayaan kendaraan bermotor dan pembiayaan multiguna untuk nasabah di seluruh Indonesia. Proses cepat, syarat ringan, dan cicilan yang bisa disesuaikan dengan kemampuan Anda.

title: Pembiayaan Mobil Baru
content: DP mulai dari 20 persen dari harga kendaraan. Tenor 12 sampai 60 bulan. Bunga flat mulai 4,25 persen per tahun. Proses persetujuan 1 sampai 3 hari kerja setelah dokumen lengkap.

title: Pembiayaan Mobil Bekas
content: Untuk kendaraan dengan usia maksimal 10 tahun pada saat pengajuan, dan maksimal 15 tahun pada saat tenor berakhir. DP mulai 25 persen. Tenor 12 sampai 48 bulan. Wajib dilakukan survei kendaraan sebelum persetujuan.

title: Pembiayaan Motor
content: DP mulai 15 persen. Tenor 11 sampai 35 bulan. Persetujuan bisa keluar di hari yang sama untuk pengajuan yang dokumennya lengkap.

title: Pembiayaan Multiguna
content: Dana tunai dengan jaminan BPKB kendaraan yang sudah Anda miliki. Plafon sampai 70 persen dari nilai taksiran kendaraan. Tenor 12 sampai 36 bulan.

title: Syarat pengajuan
content: Usia 21 sampai 55 tahun pada saat pengajuan, dan maksimal 60 tahun saat tenor berakhir Warga Negara Indonesia dengan KTP yang masih berlaku Penghasilan tetap minimal Rp 4.000.000 per bulan Masa kerja minimal 1 tahun untuk karyawan, atau usaha berjalan minimal 2 tahun untuk wiraswasta Cicilan tidak boleh melebihi 35 persen dari penghasilan bulanan Tidak sedang memiliki tunggakan di lembaga pembiayaan lain

title: Dokumen yang diperlukan
content: KTP pemohon dan pasangan Kartu Keluarga Slip gaji 3 bulan terakhir, atau laporan keuangan usaha Rekening koran 3 bulan terakhir NPWP untuk pembiayaan di atas Rp 100.000.000

title: Pembayaran angsuran
content:
Angsuran dibayarkan setiap bulan pada tanggal jatuh tempo yang tercantum di perjanjian pembiayaan. Pembayaran dapat dilakukan melalui transfer bank, virtual account, gerai retail yang bekerja sama, atau langsung di kantor cabang Solara.
Kalau tanggal jatuh tempo jatuh di hari libur, pembayaran bisa dilakukan di hari kerja berikutnya tanpa dikenakan denda.

title: Keterlambatan pembayaran
content:
Denda keterlambatan sebesar 0,5 persen per hari dari jumlah cicilan yang tertunggak, dihitung sejak hari pertama setelah tanggal jatuh tempo. Denda maksimal 30 persen dari nilai satu angsuran.
Jika keterlambatan mencapai 30 hari, akun akan dihubungi oleh tim penagihan. Pada keterlambatan 60 hari, akan diterbitkan surat peringatan pertama. Pada keterlambatan 90 hari, kendaraan dapat ditarik sesuai ketentuan perjanjian pembiayaan.

title: Kesulitan membayar
content: Kalau Anda sedang mengalami kesulitan, hubungi kami sebelum jatuh tempo. Ada beberapa opsi yang bisa dibicarakan, antara lain penjadwalan ulang tenor, keringanan denda untuk kasus tertentu, dan pengaturan pembayaran bertahap. Semua opsi memerlukan persetujuan dan dokumen pendukung.

source_ref: web/multifinance-indonesia.html#Berapa cicilan per bulan kalau tenor 24 bulan?
title: Berapa cicilan per bulan kalau tenor 24 bulan?
content: Tergantung harga kendaraan, besar DP, dan suku bunga yang berlaku. Sebagai gambaran, pembiayaan Rp 150.000.000 dengan tenor 24 bulan dan bunga flat 4,25 persen menghasilkan angsuran sekitar Rp 6.780.000 per bulan. Simulasi resmi bisa diminta ke marketing kami.

title: Bisa nggak DP-nya dikurangi?
content: DP minimum diatur oleh ketentuan dan tidak bisa diturunkan di bawah batas tersebut. Yang bisa disesuaikan adalah tenor, yang akan mempengaruhi besar cicilan bulanan.

source_ref: web/multifinance-indonesia.html#Kalau saya mau melunasi lebih cepat, bagaimana?
title: Kalau saya mau melunasi lebih cepat, bagaimana?
content: Pelunasan dipercepat bisa dilakukan kapan saja. Ada biaya penalti sebesar 3 persen dari sisa pokok jika pelunasan dilakukan sebelum setengah masa tenor berjalan. Setelah itu tidak ada penalti.

title: BPKB saya ditahan sampai kapan?
content: BPKB disimpan sebagai jaminan selama masa pembiayaan berjalan, dan dikembalikan paling lambat 14 hari kerja setelah pelunasan penuh diterima dan diverifikasi.

title: Branch partnership benefits
content: Operational, marketing and technology support is provided to branch partners. Partners receive a dedicated relationship manager, access to the Solara agent portal, co-funded local marketing, and a full onboarding programme for new staff. Systems, quotation tools and customer documents are supplied and maintained by Solara at no cost to the partner.

title: What a branch partner provides
content: A staffed location within an agreed territory At least two licensed advisers on site during business hours Adherence to Solara sales conduct and complaint handling standards Monthly reporting through the agent portal

title: Commission structure
content:
Commission is paid on premiums received, not on premiums written, and is released monthly in arrears. Rates vary by product line and by policy year.
Product line | Year 1 | Year 2 | Year 3 onwards
Health Shield | 18% | 7% | 4%
Term Life | 32% | 9% | 5%
Whole Life | 40% | 12% | 6%
Educational Plan | 28% | 10% | 5%
Multifinance | 2.5% of amount financed | n/a | n/a
Commission is subject to clawback if a policy lapses within the first 12 months. The clawback is proportionate to the unexpired portion of that first year.

title: Becoming an accredited agent
content: Individual agents may be accredited without operating a branch. Accreditation requires a valid licence from the relevant regulator, completion of Solara product training, and a clear regulatory record. Accredited agents receive the same portal access and product support as branch partners, but do not receive co-funded marketing or a relationship manager.

title: Bancassurance partnerships
content: Solara works with bank partners in the Philippines to distribute the Bank Partner Plan. Bank staff act as referral partners and are not required to hold an insurance licence, provided they refer rather than advise. All advice and underwriting is carried out by Solara.

title: Training and support
content: New partners complete a four day induction covering products, compliance, the agent portal and the quotation tools. Refresher training is provided quarterly, and product update briefings are issued whenever terms change. A partner support line operates during business hours.

title: How to apply
content: Partnership enquiries are handled by the regional distribution team. Applications are assessed on location, existing customer base, staffing and regulatory standing. The assessment usually takes three to four weeks.
